names.avg3_170: Chico del Distrito de las Cenizas

steps: You never expected to find Aunt Allie here. It turns out she fled Emor with the children and made this place their new orphanage. To keep their location a secret, she refuses to let the White Cat Troupe dig any deeper.
You three! Drop your weapons! On the ground, hands on your heads! Move it!
Eek! Okay, okay, I-I get it! Please don't hurt me!==W== No to violence!
Good! Now you two, do exactly what she did! Hurry up!
Taking Iris's cue,==W== I drop into a crouch and scan the room.
... Huh? It's too dark to see clearly...==W== Wait, where's Amber?
Good. You two are being smart.
Hey! You over there! Quit stalling! I said hurry up!
Ahh, it's not that I'm refusing!
I want to drop my sword, but the strap is totally stuck!
Hah! Can't even handle your own weapon, and you call yourselves thieves?
Thieves? What are you talking about?
Hmph, whatever. This sword is mine now. Stay right there and don't try anything funny.
Amber drops from the rafters and subdues the entire group in seconds.
Dang it! Take this! Floor Split!
An icy blue mist spreads outward from Iris's palms pressed against the floor. The wood beneath our feet lets out a few creaking groans, but remains intact.
No way! Why didn't the trap go off?!
A thief who knows magic?! Then try this!
... Huh? Whaaaat?! No way! You caught our arrows barehanded?!
What do you mean, no way? These crossbows are basically toys. The shots had zero power behind them...
These kids are fast. Dodging all over the place, but we got 'em.
Wait, isn't this the Dark-Footed Devil Cat's lair? Why are there kids here? And with Desert Scorpion magic guns?
Hmm... This room's decor is familiar. And their ambush tactics... I swear I've seen them before.
Hah! You stupid thieves, think you won just because you caught us?
This is the Dark-Footed Devil Cat's turf, the Daisy Orphanage. Run while you can, or we'll scream!
Scream for that devil cat of yours?
A devil out in this desert? Even if it is real, anyone who uses kids to do their dirty work is scum. All the more reason to teach them a lesson!
Tch, you're dead. Three, two, one... Everybody, scream!
Why are the lights flickering? Don't tell me there actually is a devil...
What was that? It's too fast, I can't track it.
I-I'll find the switch and stabilize the lamp. You protect Boss!
Doesn't matter how fast you are. If you move in a straight line... Right here!
The lights flicker back on. Noya's sword hangs in mid-air, effortlessly blocked by a broom.
I don't know if you're thieves or after something else.
But breaking into this orphanage means you crossed a line in this desert.
And no matter how much you beg...
No way... The Dark-Footed Devil Cat is...?
Then... Those two must be Iris and Amber?
What is going on? Am I dreaming? How did the orphanage and Aunt Allie end up out here in the desert?
The orphanage, Aunt Allie...!==W== So she's the director of the Ash Orphanage they've been looking for this whole time.
Oh, thank goodness...! Seeing you all looking so healthy and full of life… I am... I am so glad!
We didn't come to Mirage looking for the orphanage,==W== but what an incredible surprise.
Hold on. What did you call me?
Auntie? How distant... I am heartbroken.==W== Where did my three little darlings go? The ones who used to swarm me and call me Mom?
After moving from Emor to Mirage, I worried I might never see you three again...
But I never dreamed our reunion would look like this. Not only have you stopped calling me Mom, but you break in like a pack of thieves!
No, no, no! I keep telling you, we're not thieves!
To think you three turned bad..==W==. I suppose that's my fault as your Mom. Well... This seems like the perfect chance to teach you a lesson.
Why?! No! Wait, it's a huge misunderstanding! We came looking for the desert Monolith and only stopped in Mirage to restock!
We're here because we heard there was intel about the Monolith! Plus, everyone said this place was taken over by the Dark-Footed Devil Cat, so naturally we had to sneak in!
That is still breaking and entering. I never imagined reuniting with my precious children would end up like this. How tragic.
Come along now. Let Mom teach you a lesson.
Carried off by the scruff like kittens...==W== Wait, I'm still here.
You must be a friend of theirs.
Yes, I'm ==PLAYER_NAME== from their guild. Uh... Noya, Iris, and Amber are good kids. It's not what it looks like...
Please, let me explain...==W== Wait, you know?
Stand behind me. When the White Cats come in, make sure you have a good excuse for being in Mirage.
A good excuse?==W== What does that mean?
Apologies for the late intrusion. I am Kasimira, Captain of the White Cat Troupe's Third Squad. I need a word with you... Do you have a moment?
The door is unlocked. Come in.
22:10, Nebula Month 7th, Mirage, The Daisy Orphanage
Good evening, Director Allie. I apologize for the hour. I hope we didn't startle the children.
Oh, don't worry. They're fast asleep by now. But Captain Kasimira, you've brought quite a crowd. What brings you here?
Let me be clear—we aren't here to fight. We're investigating the brawl that happened in town today, to see if anyone knows anything.
A brawl? I'm afraid I've been here all day. Did something happen in town?

This morning, the Desert Scorpions and the Imperial Guard got into their usual street fight. But witnesses say neither side won. Someone in a White Cat uniform ended it, using two of our standard-issue magic pistols.
You would think so. But our weapons are assigned to specific members. Dual-wielding is the signature style of one specific person... But...
No one in the Troupe currently uses two guns.
I believe someone is impersonating us. They want to upset the balance and shatter the peace we have in Mirage.
Neither the Troupe nor I will sit back and let that happen. We refuse to let Mirage fall back into chaos.
Mirage was already peaceful when we moved here. I honestly have a hard time picturing this past chaos.
But what does this have to do with the orphanage? For the children's sake, we certainly don't want any trouble either.
Heh heh. That impostor is crafty, I'll give them that. Even I, wielder of the Evil Eye, was stumped at first! They must have used a high-grade magical barrier to warp perception.
But! No matter what masterful techniques they use to hide, the world is now veiled in shadow.
With the dark power surging,==W== absolutely nothing escapes my Evil Eye!
Right, uh... Basically, I couldn't find them all day. But tonight the fake finally showed up. I tailed them straight to the orphanage.
So that is where we stand. Director Allie, has anything unusual happened here tonight?
Unusual? No, I don't believe so.==W== At most, we had this Trekker stop by asking for a bed... Right?
Clearly Allie is covering for us...==W== I'd better play along and make the story stick.
A Trekker looking for lodging... Suspicious. Why would a Trekker come to a desolate, dangerous place like Mirage, especially when there's no Monolith?
I was commissioned by Executive Director Firenze of United Harvest Philae. I'm here to survey the local agricultural goods.
It seems there aren't any inns in town, so I'm relying on the kindness of the locals for a place to sleep. That's all.
Is the White Cat Troupe a registered company? If you have a problem, take it up with mine.
United Harvest Philae... The Desert Scorpions raided them recently. Were you involved?
They stormed our banquet, yes. We want them brought to justice, but that is not my business in Mirage.
No, no! This is not the one with the guns. I clearly saw four people entering this orphanage. Where are the other three?
You must be mistaken. I took this job alone. The kids were showing me the way. You probably saw me walking with them.
Yeah! We found ==SEX4== on the street. ==SEX1== had nowhere to stay, so we brought ==SEX4== back.
Ugh—my dark power has locked on to three other presences! Move, let me in to search.
Did you not hear me the first time? The children are sleeping. No one is going inside.
Why?! Kasimira, I swear on the dark power. I know I saw others in there.
I'm not saying you're wrong. But we've intruded enough at this hour. Pushing the issue would just be rude. It violates the desert code and the White Cat spirit.
Director Allie, I apologize for the disturbance.==W== If you spot anyone impersonating a White Cat, please inform us.
Before we leave, I have a personal question. Are you familiar with the name Taffett?
Taffett? I have never heard that name. Is it a person?
I see. Forget I asked.==W== Third Squad, move out.
Phew. We actually pulled that off.
Good job keeping up the act.==W== But honestly, those three are far too reckless. They had no idea they were being tailed.
Are they going to be alright? I am worried.
Oh, I haven't properly introduced myself. I'm Allie. I'm the mother here. That makes me both the caretaker and the director.
I'm ==PLAYER_NAME==. I'm the CEO of a company called Boss Accord. Because of my title, everyone calls me Boss.
Noya and the others saved me in the desert a few months ago. I've been traveling with them ever since.
A corporate CEO? How impressive. Hehehe, those kids are always full of surprises.
22:30, Nebula Month 7th, Mirage, The Daisy Orphanage
Locking us up out of nowhere, I thought something terrible happened. Turns out we were being followed. Aunt Allie, you could've said so from the start!
Noya, you can't keep a secret. Iris, the second you panic, it's written all over your face.
And I am still mad you call me Auntie instead of Mom!
Does that last part even count?! Alright, fine, we'll try. Right, Iris?
M-Mom...==W== No, I can't do it! It's too embarrassing, my face is on fire!
Honestly, you used to call me that all the time when you were little...
Anyway, you've barely stepped foot in Mirage, and you've already crossed the White Cats. Now that you're mixed up in this, the Scorpions and the Guard will be after you next.
Stay hidden here with me. It might be an orphanage, but the Cats, the Scorpions, and the Guard know better than to start trouble here.
She said she worried they'd turn bad, yet she covered for us without hesitation. She thought we were in trouble and wanted to keep us safe.
So this is what home feels like. A mother's warmth... For someone who doesn't even know where to return to, I'm truly envious...
It's not that serious! We're kids from your orphanage, we wouldn't cause trouble. And even if we did, we'd never bring it home.
Speaking of which, we meant to ask. Why did the orphanage vanish from Emor without a word? Was it because of United Harvest?
It's a long story. If you're not tired, why don't we chat while the kids are asleep?==W== I want to hear everything you've been up to since you left.
Yes! Let's all lie down and roll on the floor while listening to stories! Just like when we were little.
Despite the long separation, Noya, Iris, and Amber don't miss a beat. They fall right back into their old rhythm, as if they only left yesterday.
They pull me onto the soft sofas with them. Over warm tea, we settle in for a long, heartwarming night of stories.
